{{Quote|I just hope whatever it is we're facing is planetside, sir. I'd rather die with dirt, not deckplates, under my boots.|Kite|<ref name="TCW:S" />}}
'''Kite''' was the name for a [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone trooper commander]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], he was assigned to the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Laudable]]'' under the command of the [[Bardottan/Legends|Phuii]] [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Ares Nune/Legends|Ares Nune]]. Nune's forces had been dispatched to the [[Phu system/Legends|Phu system]] to patrol for any [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] activity in the area. While Kite was talking to Nune on the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of the ''Laudable'', the task force was [[Battle of the Phu system/Legends|attacked]] by the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']], a Confederacy [[Warship/Legends|warship]] equipped with two giant [[Ion pulse cannon/Legends|ion pulse cannons]] on each of its sides. Under the command of Confederacy [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], the ''Malevolence'' destroyed the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] of the entire [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] with the [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]]. After doing so, the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] proceeded to destroy Nune's entire task force, using its [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] to obliterate the exposed ships, and eliminating General Nune, Kite, and their forces.

==Biography==
{{Quote|It's like the great slug from that old story, eh, Commander Kite? The one that's lurking out there, waiting to be found.''"<br />"''Not familiar with that one, sir. If it's not a combat manual, I'm afraid I haven't read it.|Nune and Kite, while searching for Separatist activity|<ref name="TCW:S" />}}
Kite was the name of a [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone trooper commander]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="TCW:S" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC" /> during the height of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Kite was assigned to the [[Bardottan/Legends|Phuii]] [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Ares Nune/Legends|Ares Nune]]. Nune was in charge of a Republic task force, made up of at least three [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]], to patrol the [[Phu system/Legends|Phu system]] for any Separatist activity.<ref name="TCW:S" /> Kite himself was assigned to the ''[[Laudable]]'',<ref name="Prelude">''[[The Clone Wars: Prelude]]''</ref> one of the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] in the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]].<ref name="TCW:S" />

While on patrol, the task force's initial sweeps reported no enemy activity, and Nune ordered another sweep of the surrounding area to be sure. While the secondary sweeps were underway, Kite and Nune were both on the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of the ''Laudable'', and the two began to discuss the mission.<ref name="TCW:S" />

[[File:Kite_Nune_talking.png|thumb|left|250px|Kite talks to Nune, shortly before their deaths.]]
However, a new Confederate weapon was hiding out of sight of the Republic task force, in the form of the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']]. The ''Malevolence'' was a [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]] under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], the [[Cyborg/Legends|Cyborg]] [[Supreme Commander]] of the Separatist's [[Droid Army]]. As Kite and Nune were finishing up their conversation, Grievous ordered the ''Malevolence'' to [[Battle of the Phu system/Legends|fire]] one of its two [[Ion pulse cannon/Legends|ion pulse cannons]] at the Republic task force, which disabled the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] of the entire [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]. Nune's task force was caught off guard, and General Nune, Kite, and their fleet was destroyed by the ''Malevolence''{{'s}} [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] batteries.<ref name="TCW:S" /> The loss of Nune's battle group was later reported in a press release by [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]], along with an audio recording of Nune during the attack that had survived the battle.<ref name="HoloNet News — A Galaxy Divided">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/hnn/001.html#rss|text=HoloNet News — A Galaxy Divided|int=HoloNet News — A Galaxy Divided}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|You have a refreshingly singular outlook, Kite. The enemy had best be prepared.|Ares Nune|<ref name="TCW:S" />}}
Kite was a very singular-minded soldier, having only read manuscripts relating to combat. His mindset kept him from relating fully to his [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] General, and when Ares Nune tried to strike up a conversation, likening their search to an old fable, Kite was uninterested. Kite thought himself better suited to ground operations, and felt uncomfortable being aboard a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] rather than on solid planetary ground. He had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], black [[Hair/Legends|hair]], tan skin, and a number of scars covering his face.<ref name="TCW:S" /> Like all other clone troopers, Kite stood at 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="clone troopers" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kite made his first appearance in the six-page [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|''The Clone Wars'' webcomic]] [[The Clone Wars: Shakedown|''Shakedown'']], which led into "[[Rising Malevolence|Rising ''Malevolence'']],"<ref name="TCW:S" /> an episode in the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''.<ref name="Rising Malevolence Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode002.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Rising ''Malevolence''}}</ref> The loss of General Nune's task force was mentioned in ''[[HoloNet News — A Galaxy Divided]]'', the first installment of the [[HoloNet News (podcast)|online HoloNet News podcast series]] that took place between the events of the comic and the episode.<ref name="HoloNet News — A Galaxy Divided" />
